language.note: Putonghua is the sole official national language; regional/minority languages (Cantonese, Tibetan, Uyghur, Mongolian, etc.) are extensive but not co-official nationally
language.script: Simplified Chinese characters (Hanzi); Hanyu Pinyin Latin-alphabet romanization frequently appears alongside characters on road signs

terrainDescription.zh: 地形極端多樣：西部高原山地（青藏高原）、北部沙漠與草原、東部沿海平原與高度都市化地帶並存於同一國家
terrainDescription.en: Extremely varied terrain: western highland plateaus (Tibetan Plateau), northern deserts and steppe, and densely urbanized eastern coastal plains all within one country

plate.color: blue background/white text (standard private cars); yellow background/black text (trucks, buses, special-use vehicles); green background/black text (new-energy vehicles); white (police); black (some military/consular)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: No single strongly distinctive national bollard style documented

utilityPole.transformerMount: Commonly circular or square cross-section concrete poles; no single strongly distinctive national transformer-mount style documented

historicalContext.zh: 現代中國大陸使用1950年代後簡化的「簡體字」，並普遍搭配漢語拼音（拉丁字母標音）並列於路牌，此點是與使用繁體字的台灣/香港最直接的文字辨識差異。
historicalContext.en: Mainland China uses Simplified Chinese characters (simplified since the 1950s) and commonly pairs them with Hanyu Pinyin Latin-alphabet transliteration on road signs — the most direct script-based way to distinguish it from Traditional-Chinese-using Taiwan/Hong Kong.
